product.summary: Provider-operated cloud wallet using Fireblocks MPC infrastructure with deposits, withdrawals, transfers, swaps and integrated lending.
product.key_management_model: Fireblocks MPC-CMP; independent user recovery not established
product.notes: Do not infer independent self-custody from MPC terminology. The reviewed record does not establish a user-controlled seed or service-independent recovery path.

events.title: IZAKA-YA service launch period
events.description: Izakaya Limited states that the IZAKA-YA wallet service began in December 2023. Current service materials describe a cloud wallet using Fireblocks MPC infrastructure.
events.notes: Month precision follows the operator company profile; no day is inferred.

events.title: IZAKA-YA announced account-level transfer/withdrawal restrictions and mandatory KYC
events.description: IZAKA-YA stated that some accounts were temporarily restricted from transfers and withdrawals while transactions suspected of illicit-fund or money-laundering involvement were investigated. The same notice announced mandatory KYC for all users and warned that ordinary transfer/withdrawal processing could take longer during enhanced monitoring.
events.notes: This records a provider/account-access and operating-policy change. The operator explicitly stated that this was not a uniform platform-wide withdrawal halt. Do not infer insolvency, customer loss, Fireblocks compromise, criminal conduct by a specific user, or a self-custody/custody transition.
